requests.name: Scan Drive files with permissions
requests.description: One page of the signed-in person's non-trashed Google Drive files across My Drive and every shared drive, each with its owners and, where Drive returns them, its permissions (person, email, role). Pass pageToken from the previous page's nextPageToken to continue. Read-only.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Drive search query; defaults to every non-trashed file.

parameters.name: corpora
parameters.description: Where to search; allDrives covers My Drive and all shared drives.

parameters.name: includeItemsFromAllDrives
parameters.description: Include shared-drive items.

parameters.name: supportsAllDrives
parameters.description: The caller supports shared drives.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Files per page.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: The exact nextPageToken from the previous page; omit for the first page.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Partial-response field mask; keep the default.

requests.name: List one Drive file's permissions
requests.description: Every permission on one Google Drive file, folder or shared drive: person or group, email, role, and whether it is inherited from a shared drive or folder. Used for shared-drive files, which the bulk scan returns without permissions. Read-only.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: The Drive file, folder or shared drive id.

parameters.name: supportsAllDrives
parameters.description: The file may be in a shared drive; keep true.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Permissions per page.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: The exact nextPageToken from the previous page; omit for the first page.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Partial-response field mask; keep the default.

requests.name: Who is signed in to Drive
requests.description: The display name, email address and permission id of the person signed in to Google Drive, so the app can leave their own account out of the people it lists. Read-only.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Partial-response field mask; keep the default.

requests.name: List Drive shared drives
requests.description: The names and ids of the shared drives the signed-in person can see, so the app can show which shared drive each file lives in. Read-only.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Shared drives per page.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: The exact nextPageToken from the previous page; omit for the first page.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Partial-response field mask; keep the default.

requests.name: Get one Drive file's name and link
requests.description: The name, link, type, shared-drive id and whether the signed-in person can share it, for one Google Drive file or folder by id. Used to show exactly which file a share request is about before anything is shared. Read-only.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: The Drive file or folder id.

parameters.name: supportsAllDrives
parameters.description: The file may be in a shared drive; keep true.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Partial-response field mask; keep the default.

requests.name: Get one shared drive's name
requests.description: The name and id of one Google shared drive, by its drive id. Used to show exactly which shared drive a share or removal request is about before anything changes. Read-only.

parameters.name: drive_id
parameters.description: The shared drive id.

requests.name: Remove a person's access to a Drive file
requests.note: A selected original tool: it becomes a pending Request after select_connector_tools. Revise it to these parameters before approving.
requests.description: Delete one permission from one Google Drive file, folder or shared drive, by file id (or shared drive id) and permission id (from the scan or the permissions list). The person loses the access that permission gave; access they hold another way, such as from a parent folder or shared drive, remains. An owner's permission cannot be removed. Google sends no notification. Changes who can open the file. Use it only after a person has confirmed the removal in the app.

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: The Drive file or folder id.

parameters.name: permission_id
parameters.description: The permission id to delete, as returned by the scan or the file's permission list.

parameters.name: supportsAllDrives
parameters.description: The file may be in a shared drive; keep true.

requests.name: Give a person access to a Drive file
requests.note: A selected original tool: it becomes a pending Request after select_connector_tools. Revise it to these parameters before approving. This drops the domain, link-sharing, ownership-transfer and domain-admin parameters.
requests.description: Share one Google Drive file, folder or shared drive with one person or Google Group by email address at a chosen access level. For a shared drive, file_id is the drive id and the person becomes a member of the whole drive. Use type user or group with an email_address, and role reader (view), commenter or writer (edit); do not use any other type or role. It has no domain, link-sharing or ownership-transfer parameters, but it does not itself reject type anyone, so the caller must not send it. Sends Google's usual notification email unless send_notification_email is false. Changes who can open the file. Use it only after a person has confirmed in the app's share request.

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: The Drive file, folder or shared drive id.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Who is being given access: user for a person or group for a Google Group. Never anyone or domain.

parameters.name: email_address
parameters.description: The email address of the person or group.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Access level: reader (view), commenter or writer (edit). Never owner.

parameters.name: send_notification_email
parameters.description: Whether Google emails the person that the file was shared with them. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: email_message
parameters.description: Optional plain-text message for the notification email.

parameters.name: expiration_time
parameters.description: Optional RFC 3339 time at which the access ends, at most a year ahead.

parameters.name: supports_all_drives
parameters.description: The file may be in a shared drive; keep true.
